common.tagline: Beautiful, accessible, animated components for Khmer and international applications.

home.title: Angkor UI
home.subtitle: Copy-Owned Khmer/English React Components
home.description: Angkor UI is an open-source bilingual component library. Built on Radix primitives and powered by Motion for React, designed specifically to meet the high typographic demands of Khmer script alongside English.
home.featureCopyOwnedDesc: No heavy node_modules package. Install components directly into your source code and customize them freely.
home.featureKhmerDesc: Perfect font scaling and line heights for Noto Sans Khmer and Khmer OS System, preventing text clipping.
home.featureAnimatedDesc: Smooth micro-animations out-of-the-box that adapt to user preferences and reduced motion.
home.featureAccessibleDesc: Adheres to WAI-ARIA standards, supporting keyboard navigation and screen readers.

docs.introDesc: Learn about Angkor UI's goals, structural design, and typography guidelines.
docs.installDesc: How to set up the library workspace, Tailwind CSS themes, and Noto Sans Khmer fonts.
docs.cliDesc: Automate project setup and component downloads using our custom CLI.
